title: Glitches
body: ** I did purchase the onetime lifetime offer after I wrote the below. It’s a beautiful app, just needs some tweaks. ** 1. The “Export Ingredients to List” only exports the recipe name and not the list of ingredients. 2. There is a need to print, copy or enlarge the process instructions and ingredient text. 3. It’s a beautiful app. However, I think the above issues need to be resolved before I’ll pay for the app. 4. I’ll relook my rating and review if the app is updated.
